# Pipeline Run State
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Create or update this file at `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` whenever the pipeline starts, pauses, blocks, resumes, or completes.

```markdown
# Pipeline Run State
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

**Workspace:** {{WORKSPACE_SLUG}}
**Run:** {{RUN_PATH}}
**Status:** Running / Blocked / Paused / Complete / Cancelled
**Current stage:** [stage path]
**Resume stage:** [stage path or None]
**Last completed stage:** [stage path or None]
**Quality attempt:** [number]
**Quality score:** [percentage or Not measured]
**Quality gate:** Pending / Failed / Passed
**Governance state:** Governance pending / Accepted / Accepted with monitored actions / Rejected or obsolete
**Updated:** [date and time]

## Block Or Pause

**Reason:** [why work cannot continue, or why the user paused it]
**Input or action needed:** [one specific request, or None]
**Requested from:** [person, role, or system]
**Blocked or paused at:** [stage path or None]

## Resume

**Resume command:** `Resume this pipeline`
**Resume condition:** [what must be true before continuing]
**Evidence:** [paths to the relevant output, audit, or user-provided information]
```

Keep the state factual and current. Do not mark a run `Complete` before `what-now.md` has been written.
